title.narrative: for strengthening the network of agricultural policy research centers in Africa

description.narrative: The Africa Network of Agricultural Policy Research Institutes (ANAPRI) is a consortium of independent agricultural policy think tanks and research centers across Africa, dedicated to generating high-quality, evidence-based research that supports effective policymaking. Its mission is to strengthen the capacity of African research institutes, enabling them to produce impactful research that shapes policy decisions at the national, regional, and continental levels. ANAPRI seeks to position its member centers as the best resource for their governments, ensuring that their research findings are integrated into key policy discussions and decisions. This grant will support capacity building, institutional development, and strategic engagement, helping ANAPRI centers become the go-to advisors for their governments. (Strategy: Evidence-Informed Policymaking)
